title: WinWinCode ClientControlPort v1
description: Transport-neutral contract between the WinWinCode Server Control Plane and the WinWinCode Device Client for enrollment, presence, access challenges, exclusive occupancy, repository projections, worker supervision, and candidate delivery. Local absolute paths never cross this contract; connect codes appear only as codeDigest values.

commandFields.conflict: expectedRevision mismatch is rejected without state change; an identical idempotencyKey with an identical payload replays the first result

occupancyFencingFields.appliesTo: every message with x-message-class command that involves occupancy or task execution
occupancyFencingFields.staleFencingToken: a fencing token below the current occupancy token is rejected before any local effect

redelivery.condition: same messageId and payload digest after reconnect or server restart
redelivery.effect: acknowledge without a second state transition

x-winwincode-semantics.pathBan: no field of this contract carries a local absolute path; repository locations resolve only inside the Device Client local database
x-winwincode-semantics.connectCodeBan: connect code material appears only as codeDigest; plaintext connect codes never enter this contract

ClientControlMessageId.description: Unique identity of one ClientControlPort message envelope.

ClientExchangeSequence.description: Strictly increasing per-client exchange stream position used for acknowledgement and replay.

IdempotencyKey.description: Opaque retry identity of one command; the same key with the same payload replays the first result.

OccupancyFencingToken.description: Monotonically increasing occupancy fencing token encoded as a string to preserve 64-bit precision. Every new occupancy mints a higher token; stale tokens are always rejected.

ClientNodeId.description: Identity of one registered Device Client node.

PublicClientId.description: Stable user-visible Client ID used to look up a pending or active ClientNode. It is public and never a credential.

ClientInstanceId.description: Identity of one Device Client process boot; changes after every restart.

ClientConnectCodeId.description: Identity of one one-time dynamic connect code publication.

ClientAccessChallengeId.description: Identity of one pending access challenge sent to the Device Client before a grant is created.

ClientAccessGrantId.description: Identity of one user-to-client access grant.

ClientOccupancyLeaseId.description: Identity of one exclusive occupancy lease. At most one active lease exists per ClientNode.

OccupancyClaimId.description: Identity of one atomic occupancy claim attempt.

RepositoryBindingId.description: Identity of one ClientNode-local repository binding. The absolute local path stays in the Device Client local database and never crosses this contract.

RepositoryAccessGrantId.description: Identity of one user-to-repository access grant.

WorkerLaunchGrantId.description: Identity of one single-use worker launch grant.

LocalCandidateReceiptId.description: Identity of one client-issued candidate retention receipt.

LocalApplyReceiptId.description: Identity of one client-issued local apply receipt.

GitCommitSha.description: Full git commit object name in SHA-1 or SHA-256 form.

GitRefName.description: Git branch or ref name as accepted by git check-ref-format. Full git ref-format rules are enforced by git itself.

CandidateRef.description: Stable local git ref that survives worktree cleanup.

ClientDisplayName.description: User-chosen display name for a ClientNode or repository binding.

UserAccountState.title: UserAccountState
UserAccountState.description: Lifecycle state of a user account; disabled accounts lose every active browser session immediately.

ClientNodePresenceState.title: ClientNodePresenceState
ClientNodePresenceState.description: Machine-level presence of a ClientNode. It belongs to no browser session.

ClientLockState.title: ClientLockState
ClientLockState.description: Operator lock toggle of a ClientNode; locked blocks new connections and occupancy regardless of presence.

ClientPlatformTarget.title: ClientPlatformTarget
ClientPlatformTarget.description: Supported release target triple of the reporting Device Client.

ClientArchitecture.title: ClientArchitecture
ClientArchitecture.description: Machine architecture of the reporting Device Client.

ClientConnectCodeState.title: ClientConnectCodeState
ClientConnectCodeState.description: Lifecycle state of a one-time connect code.

ClientTrustMode.title: ClientTrustMode
ClientTrustMode.description: Trust mode of a ClientAccessGrant; trusted only skips the connect code, never occupancy, repository ACL, or presence checks.

ClientOccupancyLeaseState.title: ClientOccupancyLeaseState
ClientOccupancyLeaseState.description: Exclusive occupancy lifecycle of one ClientNode. At most one active lease exists per ClientNode and it belongs to a userId, not to a browser cookie.

ClientOccupancyReleaseMode.title: ClientOccupancyReleaseMode
ClientOccupancyReleaseMode.description: Requested release behavior; drain_then_release finishes active tasks, cancel_tasks_and_release cancels them first.

ClientOccupancyReleaseReason.title: ClientOccupancyReleaseReason
ClientOccupancyReleaseReason.description: Recorded reason why an occupancy lease reached a released terminal state.

RepositoryKind.title: RepositoryKind
RepositoryKind.description: Supported repository kind; local git is required and remote git is optional.

RepositoryDirtyState.title: RepositoryDirtyState
RepositoryDirtyState.description: Working-tree dirty projection of the bound repository.

RepositoryAvailability.title: RepositoryAvailability
RepositoryAvailability.description: Combined repository status projection; every launch revalidates it and never trusts the previous scan.

WorkerLaunchGrantState.title: WorkerLaunchGrantState
WorkerLaunchGrantState.description: Lifecycle state of a single-use worker launch grant.

LocalCandidateReceiptState.title: LocalCandidateReceiptState
LocalCandidateReceiptState.description: Retention lifecycle of a locally frozen candidate.

LocalApplyStrategy.title: LocalApplyStrategy
LocalApplyStrategy.description: Strategy used to deliver a candidate onto its target branch.

LocalApplyResult.title: LocalApplyResult
LocalApplyResult.description: Terminal outcome of one local apply attempt; every attempt writes a LocalApplyReceipt.

ClientWorkerRunState.title: ClientWorkerRunState
ClientWorkerRunState.description: Observed run state of one supervised worker process.

WorkerReconcileState.title: WorkerReconcileState
WorkerReconcileState.description: Reconciliation verdict for one worker process after Device Client restart.

ClientChallengeAckStatus.title: ClientChallengeAckStatus
ClientChallengeAckStatus.description: Device Client verdict for one access challenge.

OccupancyRejectReason.title: OccupancyRejectReason
OccupancyRejectReason.description: Client-side reason for rejecting an offered occupancy lease.

WorkerLaunchAckStatus.title: WorkerLaunchAckStatus
WorkerLaunchAckStatus.description: Idempotent result of applying one worker launch command locally.

CommandAckStatus.title: CommandAckStatus
CommandAckStatus.description: Universal acknowledgement status for control-plane-to-client commands.

ClientRepositoryRescanReason.title: ClientRepositoryRescanReason
ClientRepositoryRescanReason.description: Why the Control Plane requests a repository rescan.

ClientWorkerStopReason.title: ClientWorkerStopReason
ClientWorkerStopReason.description: Why the Control Plane stops one supervised worker process.

ClientOccupancyForceFenceReason.title: ClientOccupancyForceFenceReason
ClientOccupancyForceFenceReason.description: Why the Control Plane force-fences a stale occupancy.

ClientCredentialRotateReason.title: ClientCredentialRotateReason
ClientCredentialRotateReason.description: Why device credential rotation is requested; credential material itself never crosses this contract.

ClientControlErrorCode.title: ClientControlErrorCode
ClientControlErrorCode.description: Stable error codes carried by ClientControlError.

ClientControlError.title: ClientControlError
ClientControlError.description: Machine-readable error fact whose optional details reuse the public redaction rules.

ClientCapacityReport.title: ClientCapacityReport
ClientCapacityReport.description: Client-reported worker session capacity. The Control Plane computes durable reservations from it and the Device Client revalidates locally; V1 never oversells.

RepositoryBindingProjection.title: RepositoryBindingProjection
RepositoryBindingProjection.description: Secret-safe repository metadata the Device Client reports to the Control Plane. It carries no local filesystem path.

ClientWorkerReconciliation.title: ClientWorkerReconciliation
ClientWorkerReconciliation.description: Reconciliation verdict for one supervised worker process after Device Client restart.

passwordHash.description: Argon2id PHC password hash. Control Plane owned; it is never returned by any projection and never leaves the server boundary.

UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Server-local user account. Ownership: Control Plane.

ClientNode.title: ClientNode
ClientNode.description: Machine-level Device Client identity and presence projection. Ownership: Device Client reports, Control Plane persists the projection.

codeDigest.description: HMAC or digest of the one-time code. The plaintext code never crosses this contract.

ClientConnectCode.title: ClientConnectCode
ClientConnectCode.description: One-time dynamic connect code record. Ownership: Control Plane stores the digest only.

expiresAt.description: Null means no expiry; temporary grants always carry one.

ClientAccessGrant.title: ClientAccessGrant
ClientAccessGrant.description: Many-to-many user-to-client permission relation. A grant never implies occupancy. Ownership: Control Plane.

acknowledgedAt.description: Set when the Device Client ACKs the fencing token; the lease enters occupied only after this.

ClientOccupancyLease.title: ClientOccupancyLease
ClientOccupancyLease.description: Exclusive occupancy of one ClientNode by one user. Ownership: Control Plane authoritative, Device Client enforces. Storage guarantees at most one active lease per clientNodeId.

lastScannedAt.description: Null before the first completed scan.

RepositoryBinding.title: RepositoryBinding
RepositoryBinding.description: Product identity and safe metadata of one ClientNode-local repository. It carries no absolutePath; the local path lives only in the Device Client local database. Ownership: Control Plane holds the product identity; the Device Client owns path resolution.

permissions.description: Restricted to use and manage; share is a client-level permission only.

RepositoryAccessGrant.title: RepositoryAccessGrant
RepositoryAccessGrant.description: Explicit per-user repository permission; a ClientAccessGrant never implies repository access. Ownership: Control Plane.

credentialDigest.description: Digest of the short-lived worker session credential. Credential material itself never crosses this contract.

WorkerLaunchGrant.title: WorkerLaunchGrant
WorkerLaunchGrant.description: Single-use binding of one occupancy lease to exactly one WorkerSession and one Worker process. Any field mismatch is rejected. Ownership: Control Plane.

LocalCandidateReceipt.title: LocalCandidateReceipt
LocalCandidateReceipt.description: Client-issued proof that a candidate commit is frozen under a stable local git ref before worktree cleanup. Ownership: Device Client issued, Control Plane audited.

resultingCommit.description: Null when the apply did not produce a commit.

oneOf.description: Opaque client-local artifact reference for conflict details; never a filesystem path.

LocalApplyReceipt.title: LocalApplyReceipt
LocalApplyReceipt.description: Audit record of one local candidate apply attempt, supporting retry and fail-closed base-stale handling. Ownership: Device Client issued, Control Plane audited.

expectedRevision.description: ClientNode revision known to the Device Client; zero identifies a not-yet-enrolled node.

ClientEnrollMessage.title: client.enroll
ClientEnrollMessage.description: First contact of one Device Client identity; creates the ClientNode in pending_enrollment. Device credential provisioning stays outside this contract.

ClientHelloMessage.title: client.hello
ClientHelloMessage.description: Announces full presence and capacity after connect or reconnect, before any other client traffic on the new exchange.

occupancyLeaseId.description: Locally mirrored active occupancy lease; null when the ClientNode holds none.

ClientHeartbeatMessage.title: client.heartbeat
ClientHeartbeatMessage.description: Reports liveness, presence, capacity, and the locally mirrored occupancy lease without dispatching commands as a side effect.

ClientConnectCodePublishedMessage.title: client.connect_code.published
ClientConnectCodePublishedMessage.description: Publishes or replaces the one-time dynamic connect code as a digest only; the plaintext code never crosses this contract.

ClientAccessChallengeAckMessage.title: client.access.challenge_ack
ClientAccessChallengeAckMessage.description: Confirms that the challenged connect code generation is still valid on the Device Client; the Control Plane may create the ClientAccessGrant only after this ACK.

ClientOccupancyAckMessage.title: client.occupancy.ack
ClientOccupancyAckMessage.description: Acknowledges the offered occupancy lease and its fencing token after persisting the local occupancy mirror; the lease enters occupied only after this ACK.

ClientOccupancyRejectedMessage.title: client.occupancy.rejected
ClientOccupancyRejectedMessage.description: Refuses an offered occupancy lease; a stale or unknown fencing token is always rejected locally and never lands.

expectedRevision.description: RepositoryBinding revision known to the Device Client; zero creates the binding projection.

ClientRepositoryUpsertMessage.title: client.repository.upsert
ClientRepositoryUpsertMessage.description: Upserts the secret-safe repository binding projection; the absolute local path never leaves the Device Client.

ClientRepositoryRemovedMessage.title: client.repository.removed
ClientRepositoryRemovedMessage.description: Withdraws a repository binding projection after local removal.

ClientRepositoryStatusMessage.title: client.repository.status
ClientRepositoryStatusMessage.description: Reports the refreshed status projection of one repository binding, for example after a rescan command.

ClientWorkerLaunchAckMessage.title: client.worker.launch_ack
ClientWorkerLaunchAckMessage.description: Returns the idempotent result of applying one worker launch command; duplicate launches reuse the first result without a second process.

ClientWorkerStateMessage.title: client.worker.state
ClientWorkerStateMessage.description: Reports the observed run state of one supervised worker process without creating product-side conclusions.

occupancyLeaseId.description: Mirrored occupancy lease under recovery; null when no lease mirror exists.

ClientWorkerReconcileMessage.title: client.worker.reconcile
ClientWorkerReconcileMessage.description: Reports local worker reconciliation after Device Client restart; presence stays degraded and occupancy recovery_pending until it is accepted.

ClientCandidateRetainedMessage.title: client.candidate.retained
ClientCandidateRetainedMessage.description: Reports that a candidate commit is frozen under a stable local git ref before worktree cleanup.

ClientCandidateApplyResultMessage.title: client.candidate.apply_result
ClientCandidateApplyResultMessage.description: Reports the receipt of one local candidate apply attempt, including fail-closed outcomes such as base_stale or working_tree_dirty.

ClientCommandAckMessage.title: client.command_ack
ClientCommandAckMessage.description: Universal idempotent acknowledgement for control-plane-to-client commands that have no dedicated ack message.

ClientEnrollmentAcceptedMessage.title: client.enrollment_accepted
ClientEnrollmentAcceptedMessage.description: Completes enrollment and returns the stable public Client ID; the public Client ID is not a credential. Device credential material never crosses this contract.

ClientAccessChallengeMessage.title: client.access.challenge
ClientAccessChallengeMessage.description: Asks the Device Client to verify that the challenged connect code generation is still valid before a ClientAccessGrant is created; the plaintext code never crosses this contract.

ClientOccupancyOfferMessage.title: client.occupancy.offer
ClientOccupancyOfferMessage.description: Offers the reserved occupancy lease; the Device Client must persist the local occupancy mirror and answer with client.occupancy.ack before the lease becomes occupied.

ClientOccupancyReleaseMessage.title: client.occupancy.release
ClientOccupancyReleaseMessage.description: Releases the occupancy; drain_then_release finishes active tasks first, cancel_tasks_and_release cancels them and requires explicit user confirmation upstream.

occupancyFencingToken.description: New fencing token minted above every prior token; the superseded token is permanently rejected.

ClientOccupancyForceFenceMessage.title: client.occupancy.force_fence
ClientOccupancyForceFenceMessage.description: Force-fences a stale occupancy after the recovery deadline or by administrator action; the previous lease and token can never land again.

ClientRepositoryRescanMessage.title: client.repository.rescan
ClientRepositoryRescanMessage.description: Requests canonicalization and a fresh scan of one repository binding; the Device Client answers with client.repository.status.

ClientWorkerLaunchMessage.title: client.worker.launch
ClientWorkerLaunchMessage.description: Launches exactly one worker process for the bound WorkerSession; the Device Client validates fencing, repository, capacity, and local state before spawning and answers with client.worker.launch_ack.

ClientWorkerStopMessage.title: client.worker.stop
ClientWorkerStopMessage.description: Stops the supervised worker process of one WorkerSession under the current occupancy fencing token.

ClientCandidateApplyMessage.title: client.candidate.apply
ClientCandidateApplyMessage.description: Applies a retained candidate onto its target branch; the Device Client verifies the candidate ref, expected HEAD, working-tree policy, fencing, and permissions before writing and answers with client.candidate.apply_result.

ClientLockMessage.title: client.client_lock
ClientLockMessage.description: Locks or unlocks the ClientNode; locked blocks new connections and occupancy regardless of presence.

ClientCredentialRotateMessage.title: client.credential_rotate
ClientCredentialRotateMessage.description: Requests device credential rotation; the rotation handshake and credential material stay outside this contract.

ClientControlMessageKind.title: ClientControlMessageKind
ClientControlMessageKind.description: Every ClientControlPort message kind: sixteen client-to-control-plane kinds followed by eleven control-plane-to-client kinds, exactly as frozen by the ClientControlPort v1 plan.

ClientControlMessage.title: ClientControlMessage
ClientControlMessage.description: The single versioned message union of the ClientControlPort exchange. Every message carries the envelope identity fields; command-class messages additionally carry expectedRevision and idempotencyKey, and occupancy or execution commands carry occupancyLeaseId and occupancyFencingToken.
